description: This file defines composable UI components for a loading wheel animation in an Android app using Jetpack Compose. It includes the main loading wheel, an overlay variant, and preview functions.

methods.name: NiaLoadingWheel
methods.description: Composable function that renders an animated loading wheel with rotating lines and color animations.

methods.name: NiaOverlayLoadingWheel
methods.description: Composable function that overlays the loading wheel within a semi-transparent surface.

methods.name: NiaLoadingWheelPreview
methods.description: Preview composable for the loading wheel component.

methods.name: NiaOverlayLoadingWheelPreview
methods.description: Preview composable for the overlay loading wheel component.
